content.text: {"id": "mm6950a2", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "A total of 389 human cases of illness were reported, with 341 (88%) classified as probable"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Within animal categories of domestic pets (52), livestock (42), and wildlife (319)"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "count/rate", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "These events occurred predominantly during May–October (98%), peaking in July (27%)."}]}, {"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Fewer than 5% of human or animal cases of illness were classified as confirmed"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Fewer than one half of all reports (39%) indicated that a visible scum had been observed."}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Within animal categories of domestic pets (52), livestock (42), and wildlife (319)"}, {"loc": "summary", "q": "the majority of human illnesses were classified as probable, and animal illnesses as suspected"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "surveillance/descriptive", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "This summary describes data from OHHABS for January 1, 2016–December 31, 2018"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "SAS (version 9.4; SAS Institute) was used to conduct descriptive analyses"}, {"loc": "note", "q": "If no total case count was reported for a group of animals, a value of two animal cases was assigned."}, {"loc": "note", "q": "Animal cases were assigned months based on data availability, using the following hierarchy"}, {"loc": "note", "q": "Data collection was restricted to positive results from environmental testing."}], "confidence": "medium", "uncertain_fields": ["data_focus", "analytic_depth"]}
